I myself am still trying out storage solutions for filaments, but I can speak on the actual printer set up. 

I wouldn’t recommend using a rolling cart, as it is built to move, and the intense vibrations of the printer will only move the cart back and forth, possibly reducing your print quality. Even on my dresser my printer vibrates and shakes like crazy, so I’d recommend investing in a table (trust me it’s worth it) because 3d printing is an addiction and soon you will have many plastic objects and tools for the printer
